Weather across Nigeria

Rain and temperature for every state, for the next 7 days.

Quick answer: This page shows today's weather and the rain expected in the next 7 days at the capital of every Nigerian state. Use it with Plant Now before you put seed in the ground.

Loading the weather…

Weather data: Open-Meteo.com, measured at each state capital. Farms far from the capital can differ. A forecast is a guide, not a promise.
